rules.title: Pre-participation screening and conservative mode
rules.statement: Eight-question screen at onboarding (ACSM 2015 logic, PAR-Q+ domains, original wording). Symptoms, or known disease while inactive, recommend medical clearance and set conservative mode until the user confirms clearance.
rules.uncertainty: Screen wording is original and untested; licence check needed before using PAR-Q+ text verbatim.

rules.title: Red-flag symptoms trigger SAFETY STOP
rules.statement: Chest pain/pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness, unusual breathlessness, palpitations, sudden severe pain, or stroke-like signs end the session immediately with calm guidance; emergency number shown; resume only after user confirms resolution or medical review; first session back LIGHT.
rules.uncertainty: Symptom list is conservative by design.

rules.title: In-session pain protocol
rules.statement: Pain is a separate gate from readiness. Joint/tendon pain <=3/10 not worsening: continue with load -10-20% or shorter range. 4-6/10 or worsening: stop the exercise, offer substitutes with joint stress <=1 for that joint, region to conservative mode. >=7/10 or sharp, swelling, instability, locking, numbness/tingling, or after a fall: stop loading the region, end session if whole-body movement affected, suggest a professional.
rules.uncertainty: Thresholds are expert practice; rehab data (supervised) allow up to 5/10.

rules.title: Persistent pain and region conservative mode
rules.statement: Same region painful in >=2 sessions or >7 days: suggest a physiotherapist/doctor; region stays conservative (joint stress <=1, RIR >=3, no failure, no jumping) until 2 consecutive pain-free sessions, then +1 stress level per week.
rules.uncertainty: No direct evidence for the exact return sequence.

rules.title: Hard workload caps
rules.statement: The engine never prescribes beyond these caps; neither the AI coach nor repeated taps can bypass them.
rules.uncertainty: Cap values are expert practice set below volumes tolerated in studies because conditioning is concurrent.

rules.title: User additions: warn, confirm, absolute ceiling
rules.statement: User may deviate. Additions beyond a cap require explicit per-addition confirmation and are logged and counted. Absolute ceiling stops accidental runaway. Additions to a painful region are blocked.

rules.title: Illness gate
rules.statement: Fever, chills, body aches, chest symptoms, vomiting or diarrhoea lock the day to RECOVERY (rest). Return per REG-005.

rules.title: Final pre-render safety validator
rules.statement: Every generated or modified session is checked: per-muscle and per-session sets, weekly SSU and planned load, HIIT count and spacing, pattern balance, pain-region exclusions, contraindications, tier compliance, screening mode, failure policy. Auto-correct and log; fallback to LIGHT; never crash; never display unvalidated.

rules.title: AI coach boundary
rules.statement: Coach explains engine decisions from the Decision Log and rule IDs; no diagnosis, medication/supplement or extreme-diet advice; can only request engine actions which the engine validates; never writes sets, reps or loads; output safety-filtered; embedded instructions treated as data; offline fallback to Tier 1.

rules.title: Coaching voice
rules.statement: Calm, competent, honest, brief, non-judgemental. No body-shaming, guilt, punishment exercise, extreme motivation or 'no pain, no gain'.

rules.title: WHO floor accounting
rules.statement: Equivalent minutes = Z1 + 2 x (Z2 + Z3 work) + optional logged walking; target >=150/week; muscle-strengthening >=2 days. If the schedule cannot meet the floor in the gym, the weekly plan says so and suggests walking.

rules.title: Training days per week
rules.statement: Train 2-6 days/week with at least one full rest day; default 3 when unknown (ASSUMPTION).

rules.title: Per-muscle exposures
rules.statement: Each major muscle gets >=2 exposures/week; an exposure is >=2 fractional hard sets in one session.
rules.uncertainty: With volume equated frequency matters little for hypertrophy; it is a volume-distribution tool.

rules.title: Resistance training days
rules.statement: Resistance training on >=2 days every week.

rules.title: Main-pattern frequency in strength blocks
rules.statement: Squat, hinge, horizontal push and horizontal pull loaded 2-3 x/week in strength blocks.

rules.title: Aerobic exposure distribution
rules.statement: Aerobic work appears on >=3 days/week when training >=3 days; short post-strength blocks count.

rules.title: Hard set definition
rules.statement: A hard set is a working set ending at RIR <=4 (RPE >=6). Warm-up sets and RIR >=5 count zero.
rules.uncertainty: Exact proximity threshold for a 'stimulating' set is uncertain.

rules.title: Fractional set counting
rules.statement: 1.0 set to each primary muscle, 0.5 to each secondary, 0 to stabilisers.
rules.uncertainty: Preprint evidence; per-exercise credits are judgement calls.

rules.title: Volume landmarks (fractional sets/muscle/week)
rules.statement: Blocks start at 'start'; usual working range; the engine never plans above 'cap'. Landmark names are coaching vocabulary.
rules.uncertainty: Individual response varies widely; values for small muscles may differ.

rules.title: Fatigue-driven volume reduction
rules.statement: If >=2 fatigue signals (DEL-001) persist across >=2 sessions, accessory sets drop 30% until they clear.

rules.title: Per-session per-muscle cap
rules.statement: Direct hard sets per muscle per session <= cap by level.

rules.title: Weekly volume progression within a block
rules.statement: Each week a muscle may gain sets only if its exercises held or improved and no fatigue signal is active.

rules.title: Systemic stress units (planning)
rules.statement: SSU = sum over sets C_ex x E_RIR + sum over conditioning t_min x Z_zone x J_modality. Weekly SSU <= level ceiling and (after 4 weeks) <= 1.15 x 3-week mean. Personal factor k = median(sRPE load / SSU) after 4 weeks.
rules.uncertainty: Novel model; coefficients are judgement and must be validated in Phase 4 simulations.

rules.title: Working sets per session cap
rules.statement: Working sets per session (including core) <= cap.

rules.title: RPE-RIR mapping validity
rules.statement: RIR = 10 - RPE used only from RPE 6 to 10 on working sets.
rules.uncertainty: RIR error ~1 rep; larger far from failure and in novices.

rules.title: RIR targets
rules.statement: Targets by level and exercise class; week 1 of a block +1 RIR, last loading week -1 (not below floor).

rules.title: Failure policy
rules.statement: RIR 0 only on the last set of FailureSafe exercises (machine, cable, isolation dumbbell, safe bodyweight), <=2 exercises/session, FULL tier, not in deload, not beginners' first 8 weeks, never on failure-unsafe lifts.

rules.title: Estimated 1RM (Epley, RIR-adjusted)
rules.statement: e1RM = load x (1 + (reps + RIR)/30); update only from sets with reps+RIR <= 12 and RIR <= 3; session value = best valid set; smoothed E <- E + 0.4 (S - E); single update capped at +5%.
rules.uncertainty: Formula accuracy falls above ~10 reps and varies by lift.

rules.title: Load selection from e1RM
rules.statement: load = e1RM / (1 + (target reps + target RIR)/30), then rounded per PROG-003; without e1RM use CAL-001.

rules.title: Teaching effort to beginners
rules.statement: First 4 weeks: rep targets plus 'how many more could you have done? 0/1/2/3/4+'; RPE language introduced gradually.

rules.title: In-session autoregulation
rules.statement: After the first working set: RPE < target-1 with reps hit -> +1 increment (<=5%); RPE > target+1 or reps below range -> -5%; net change <= +/-10% per exercise per session.

rules.title: Strength range
rules.statement: 3-6 reps at ~80-88% 1RM; 1-3 only for advanced at RPE <=8.

rules.title: Hypertrophy range
rules.statement: Compounds 6-12, isolation 8-20 near target RIR.

rules.title: Muscular endurance range
rules.statement: 15-30 reps or 30-60 s at <60% 1RM.

rules.title: Power
rules.statement: 3-5 reps at 30-70% 1RM with maximal intent; reps x sets < 24; stop when speed visibly drops.
rules.uncertainty: No velocity device; subjective speed-drop rule.

rules.title: Core dosing
rules.statement: Holds 10-45 s or 6-12 controlled reps per side.

rules.title: Conditioning units
rules.statement: Minutes, metres, watts, calories or reps by modality.

rules.title: Heavy compounds
rules.statement: >=80% or <=6 reps: 120-300 s, default 180 s.

rules.title: Moderate compounds
rules.statement: 6-12 reps: 90-150 s, default 120 s.

rules.title: Isolation / accessories
rules.statement: 60-90 s, default 75 s.

rules.title: Non-competing supersets
rules.statement: 45-75 s between paired exercises, default 60 s.

rules.title: Circuits
rules.statement: 15-45 s transitions, default 30 s.

rules.title: Core
rules.statement: 30-60 s, default 45 s.

rules.title: Autoregulated rest and compression
rules.statement: User may start next set anywhere in range; timer alerts at default; under time pressure rests shrink toward minimum, accessories first, heavy compounds last and never below minimum.

rules.title: Session sequence
rules.statement: Warm-up -> power/skill -> primary compound -> secondary compound -> accessories -> core -> conditioning -> cool-down.

rules.title: Order exceptions
rules.statement: Conditioning-priority day: conditioning moves to step 3 and lower-body strength volume -30%. Weak point may precede secondary compounds. Restricted-joint mobility moves into warm-up.

rules.title: Superset eligibility
rules.statement: Only non-competing pairs at one station or within a few steps; never heavy main lifts at RIR <=2; never across two stations in a crowded gym.

rules.title: Strength first in shared sessions
rules.statement: Resistance before conditioning except conditioning-priority days.

rules.title: Same-day separation
rules.statement: Two hard sessions on one day separated by >=6 h, else merged strength-first.

rules.title: HIIT vs heavy legs
rules.statement: No HIIT in ~24 h before heavy lower-body or power session; same day HIIT after strength.

rules.title: Low-impact modality preference
rules.statement: Low-impact, concentric-dominant modalities first; impact work <=1/week and not the day before heavy legs.

rules.title: Power protection
rules.statement: Power work at session start; never after HIIT the same day.

rules.title: Aerobic dose in strength blocks
rules.statement: Mostly Z1 and <=150 prescribed min/week in strength-emphasis blocks.

rules.title: Aerobic intensity zones
rules.statement: Talk test + CR10, optional %HRR: Z1 easy (full sentences, CR10 3-4, 40-59% HRR, moderate), Z2 tempo (talk not comfortable, CR10 5-6, 60-79%, vigorous), Z3 intervals (few words, CR10 7-9, >=80%, vigorous), Z4 sprint (CR10 10).

rules.title: Weekly intensity distribution
rules.statement: About 75-80% of aerobic minutes in Z1; remainder Z2/Z3 incl. HIIT.
rules.uncertainty: Distribution evidence comes from endurance athletes.

rules.title: Aerobic progression
rules.statement: Duration first (+2-5 min/session, <=+15%/week) to ~30-40 min Z1; then Z2 tempo; then intervals.

rules.title: Weekly HIIT ceiling
rules.statement: <=2/week; 3rd only for intermediate/advanced, FULL day, no fatigue signal or workload flag, conditioning block. >=6 min Z3 work or a circuit at CR10 >=7 for >=8 min counts as HIIT.

rules.title: HIIT protocol menu
rules.statement: Protocol chosen by block and purpose, not popularity.

rules.title: HIIT prerequisites
rules.statement: Screen clear or cleared, calibration done, >=3 weeks Z1 base; first HIIT short 1:2 at CR10 7-8.

rules.title: HIIT spacing
rules.statement: >=48 h preferred, 24 h minimum between HIIT sessions, plus CON-003.

rules.title: Per-session HIIT work caps
rules.statement: Long <=20 min work, short <=10 min, sprint <=2.5 min; <=35 min conditioning after strength.

rules.title: Excluded modalities
rules.statement: Treadmill running, all stationary bikes and stair machines are never prescribed; air/fan bikes and treadmill walking excluded until the Product Owner says otherwise.

rules.title: Modality matrix and selection score
rules.statement: Score = 0.35 stimulus fit + 0.25 (1-interference/5) x leg priority + 0.20 (1-impact/5) x joint sensitivity + 0.10 variety + 0.10 preference.

rules.title: Weekly pattern coverage
rules.statement: >=3 days: patterns 1-7 each >=1x, squat/hinge/h-push/h-pull >=2x, carry >=1x, anti-ext/anti-rot/anti-lat >=1x, rotation >=1x per 2 weeks. 2 days: 1-7 and 10-12 weekly; carry and rotation alternate weeks.

rules.title: Pull:push ratio
rules.statement: Weekly pulling sets / pushing sets between 1.0 and 1.5.

rules.title: Knee:hip ratio
rules.statement: Knee-dominant sets / hip-dominant sets between 0.67 and 1.5.

rules.title: Unilateral minimum
rules.statement: >=1 unilateral lower-body exercise/week (>=2 when >=4 days).

rules.title: Bodyweight progression levers
rules.statement: Reps -> ROM -> tempo/pauses -> leverage -> unilateral/less assistance -> added load; regressions reverse.

rules.title: Bodyweight step-up trigger
rules.statement: All sets at top of range at RIR >=1 for 2 sessions; assisted pull-up: -1 step after 3x8 at RIR 2.

rules.title: Anti-movement emphasis
rules.statement: Anti-extension, anti-rotation, anti-lateral flexion and bracing; controlled rotation; no default high-rep crunches.

rules.title: Core progression
rules.statement: Lever before load: 3 x 30-45 s or 10-12/side at ~RIR 2 for 2 sessions -> next rung.

rules.title: Core frequency and volume
rules.statement: 2-4 sessions/week, 6-12 sets/week, <=4 sets/session.

rules.title: Pre-workout dynamic mobility
rules.statement: 3-5 min dynamic drills for the session's joints inside the warm-up.

rules.title: Static stretching timing
rules.statement: Not in default warm-up; if preferred <=30 s per muscle then dynamic work. Post-session 30-60 s per chosen muscle plus 1-2 min slow breathing.

rules.title: Intra-workout mobility
rules.statement: Optional drill for the next exercise during rests if it doesn't tire the working muscle.

rules.title: Full range of motion default
rules.statement: Lift through full range by default.

rules.title: Off-day routine
rules.statement: Optional 10-20 min, 2-3x/week; 2 x 30-60 s per position.

rules.title: RAMP warm-up
rules.statement: Raise 3-5 min (CR10 2-3), Activate & Mobilise 3-4 min, Potentiate with ramp sets; 8-12 min total; HIIT days 5 min easy + 3 x 30 s builds.

rules.title: Ramp-up sets
rules.statement: First main lift: bar x 8-10 -> 50% x 5 -> 70% x 3 -> 85% x 1-2 (85% only if reps <=6 or >=80% e1RM). Working load <= bar+10 kg: one set at 50% x 8. Second main lift: 60% x 5 -> 80% x 2-3.

rules.title: Warm-up compression
rules.statement: Floor 5 min (2 min raise, 1-2 drills, 2-3 ramp sets); never removed.

rules.title: Age-adjusted warm-up
rules.statement: >=50: +2-3 min raise; >=65: + balance drill.

rules.title: Personal baseline blend
rules.statement: After >=14 check-ins in 28 days: z = (R_raw - mu28)/max(sd28, 8); R_pers = 50 + 15 clamp(z,-2,2); R = 0.6 R_raw + 0.4 R_pers. Floor: R_raw < 15 caps at LIGHT.

rules.title: Readiness tiers
rules.statement: R >= 40 FULL; 28-39 MODIFIED; 15-27 LIGHT; < 15 RECOVERY. Sleep, energy or soreness rated 1 caps at MODIFIED.
rules.uncertainty: Seed 'R < 40 = low' recast on a scale where 3 = normal = 50.

rules.title: Tier modifications
rules.statement: MODIFIED: sets -30%, RIR +1, no RIR 0, main loads <=95%, HIIT -> 15-20 min steady Z1-Z2. LIGHT: sets -50%, main loads <=85% at RIR >=3, no HIIT, 10-20 min Z1, 5-10 min mobility. RECOVERY: no resistance training; optional 10-30 min Z1 + mobility.

rules.title: Sleep-hours caps
rules.statement: <4 h caps at LIGHT; 4 to <5 h caps at MODIFIED.
rules.uncertainty: Effect size is moderate evidence; the caps are judgement.

rules.title: Fatigue-signal step-down
rules.statement: >=2 active DEL-001 signals lower the tier one step, never below LIGHT on signals alone.

rules.title: User tier choice
rules.statement: Easier tier always allowed; harder one step up with warning; never past a safety, pain-gate or screening limit.

rules.title: Session load
rules.statement: Session load (AU) = session RPE (CR10) x session minutes (pauses >10 min removed).

rules.title: sRPE collection timing
rules.statement: Asked on the summary after cool-down, ideally >=10 min after last hard effort; one prompt within 24 h if skipped.

rules.title: Weekly load, monotony, strain
rules.statement: Weekly load = 7-day sum; monotony = mean/sample SD of daily loads (rest = 0); strain = weekly load x monotony; monotony > 2.0 soft flag.

rules.title: EWMA acute:chronic ratio (soft flag)
rules.statement: Acute lambda 0.25, chronic 2/29; shown after >=28 days; > 1.5 soft flag; never described as injury risk.
rules.uncertainty: Ratio has statistical flaws and weak causal support.

rules.title: Planned weekly load cap
rules.statement: Predicted weekly load (k x planned SSU) <= 1.20 x mean of last 3 weeks; before 4 weeks <= +20% week over week; deload/return ramps exempt.

rules.title: Cold start
rules.statement: <14 days: per-session caps and calibration only; 14-27 days: week-over-week rule; >=28: all signals.

rules.title: Fatigue signals
rules.statement: F1 performance (>=2 main lifts >=3% below recent best on 2 consecutive exposures, or targets missed on >=2 lifts in 2 sessions); F2 effort creep (sRPE >= plan+1.5 in 3 of last 4); F3 readiness (7-day mean >1 SD below baseline, or raw mean <35); F4 soreness (<=2 on 3 of 5 check-ins, or same ache twice in 7 days); F5 workload (EWMA >1.5 or monotony >2.0); F6 self-report run-down twice in 7 days.

rules.title: Deload decision
rules.statement: >=3 signals: deload next session. 2 signals for >=2 sessions: lighter week (3 MODIFIED sessions) then re-check. Block end: >=1 signal -> deload, else pivot. 10 weeks without either: offer a lighter week.

rules.title: Deload prescription
rules.statement: 5-7 days; same days; sets -50%; loads 85-90% at RIR >=3; no HIIT; Z1 only; extra mobility; not total rest by default.

rules.title: Resumption after deload
rules.statement: Next block at block-start volume, loads 95-100% of pre-deload, RIR +1 in week 1.

rules.title: Autoregulated hybrid architecture
rules.statement: Blocks set emphasis; within-week DUP for main patterns; session autoregulation by readiness and RIR; beginners session-to-session progression.

rules.title: Block length
rules.statement: 4-6 loading weeks (default 5) then deload or pivot per DEL-002.

rules.title: 12-month block sequence
rules.statement: Calibrate(2) -> Foundation -> Build -> Strength -> Conditioning -> Build II -> Strength II -> Power & athleticism -> Consolidation -> Review(+2 flex).

rules.title: Non-maximal check-ins
rules.statement: Block end: e1RM trends, 10-min row/SkiErg at CR10 5, bodyweight reps at RIR 1, optional measurements; 2,000 m row opt-in for intermediate+.

rules.title: Disruption handling
rules.statement: <50% sessions pauses block clock; travel -> substitution mode; holidays -> deload/pivot/maintenance; >=14 days -> REG-004; >=4 weeks restarts block.

rules.title: Priority weighting
rules.statement: #1 priority's blocks +1 week, lowest priority's -1 (min 4); #1 priority starts at block-start + 2 sets.

rules.title: Load progression
rules.statement: All sets at top of range, mean RPE <= target+0.5, form solid, recovery ok -> smallest available step of 2.5-5%.

rules.title: Double progression
rules.statement: Reps before load; extend range up to +3 (max 15 compounds, 20 isolation) when next step >5%; on the jump, reps = max(bottom, floor(reps x old/new)).

rules.title: Rounding to real equipment
rules.statement: Nearest available load <= 2% above target, else highest below.

rules.title: Hold or reduce
rules.statement: RPE target+1..+1.5 hold; > +1.5 or reps below range on >=2 sets -> -5%; twice in a row -> -10% and REG-001 review.

rules.title: Bodyweight progression
rules.statement: Follows BW-001 and BW-002.

rules.title: Conditioning progression
rules.statement: Steady +2-5 min/session (<=15%/week) then distance/watts at same CR10; intervals +1 repeat -> longer work -> shorter rest -> +1-2% pace; sleds/carries distance then +5-10% load.

rules.title: Progression caps
rules.statement: e1RM-based intensity <=5%/week/lift (beginners 7.5%); +2 sets/muscle/week; aerobic <= +15%/week; HIIT work <= +2 min/week.

rules.title: Technique gate
rules.statement: 'Form felt solid?' yes/unsure/no after main lifts and new exercises; unsure -> hold; no -> hold + cue; two no -> offer regression.

rules.title: Failed targets
rules.statement: Three failed exposures on a lift within 3 weeks -> same-pattern variation for the block, or -10% and rebuild; counts toward F1.

rules.title: 1-2 missed sessions
rules.statement: Plan shifts; never double up; at-risk pattern merged into next session within caps.

rules.title: 3 missed sessions or 7-13 days off
rules.statement: First session back at MODIFIED with loads -5%.

rules.title: Layoff >= 14 days
rules.statement: 14-27 d: wk1 90% load/70% sets, wk2 95%/85%; 28-55 d: wk1 80%/60% then +5% load and +15% sets weekly; >=56 d: recalibrate and restart block. Age >=60 or flagged screen: next longer band.
rules.uncertainty: Direction moderate; exact percentages expert practice.

rules.title: Return after illness
rules.statement: Symptom-free 24-48 h without fever medicine: LIGHT -> MODIFIED -> normal; HIIT after 2 normal sessions; illness >=7 days also applies REG-004; mild head cold without fever: user may choose LIGHT or MODIFIED.

rules.title: Initial load calibration
rules.statement: Conservative start; after each set RIR 5+ -> +20-30%, 4 -> +10-15%, 3 -> working load, <=2 -> stop and use -5% next time; <=5 ramp sets; never above RPE 8; confirm at second exposure.

rules.title: Substitution hard filters
rules.statement: Equipment available today; no pain/limitation exceeded; not excluded; skill <= level + 1; not MOD-001.

rules.title: Substitution score
rules.statement: Weighted score: pattern 0.30, objective/stimulus 0.20, primary muscle 0.15, equipment 0.10, joint stress 0.10, difficulty 0.07, fatigue parity 0.05, preference 0.03; pattern 1.0 same / 0.5 adjacent / 0 other; <0.5 pattern never auto-picked.

rules.title: Preference learning bounds
rules.statement: Accept/reject moves preference +/-0.05 within 0-1; never overrides pattern or safety.

rules.title: Priority tiers
rules.statement: P0 warm-up + cool-down (>=2 min) -> P1 primary compound -> P2 key conditioning -> P3 secondary compounds -> P4 accessories -> P5 core/mobility.

rules.title: Compression order
rules.statement: Rests -> supersets -> P5 -> P4 -> warm-up floor -> P3 -1 set -> P2 <=40% shorter -> P1 to 2 sets; <20 min offers express session.

rules.title: Extended sessions
rules.statement: Add P4 sets toward targets, Z1 minutes, core/mobility, then skill/power; within caps.

rules.title: Time model
rules.statement: Set time = setup + reps x tempo (3.5 s) + 10 s; + rests; + 60-90 s per station change; + 5% buffer; personal factor 0.8-1.3.

rules.title: Workout generation pipeline
rules.statement: Load state -> safety/readiness gates -> slots -> exercise selection -> dose -> tier changes -> warm-up -> time fit -> safety validator -> output + Decision Log. Deterministic; ties broken by exercise ID.

rules.title: Weekly templates
rules.statement: 2: FB A/B; 3: FB A/B/C (DUP); 4: Upper/Lower x2; 5: U/L/Cond/U/L; 6: U/L/Cond/U/L/easy aerobic.

rules.title: Spacing
rules.statement: Heavy lower >=48 h apart (72 h preferred for advanced heavy squat+deadlift); <=3 consecutive hard days; HIIT per HIIT-004/CON-003.

rules.title: Rescheduling
rules.statement: Unplanned day runs next session in sequence; reduced days re-plan by priority keeping coverage and caps.

rules.title: Onboarding classification
rules.statement: Beginner <12 months consistent or not comfortable with >=2 key lifts; intermediate 12-36 months and comfortable; advanced >36 months with structure; calibration may move down, not up, in first 4 weeks.

rules.title: Level promotion
rules.statement: Beginner->intermediate when >=2 main lifts stall 3 weeks despite FULL readiness and >=80% adherence (or 9 months); intermediate->advanced after >=24 months with <0.5%/week e1RM progress over 12 weeks and >=80% adherence; >=8-week break: one level lower for 4 weeks.

rules.title: Age adjustments
rules.statement: >=50: longer warm-up, HIIT ceiling 2, deload at 2 signals, year-round power work; >=60: longer return band; >=65: balance >=3 days/week and progression caps x0.8.

rules.title: Sex and prior injury
rules.statement: Same algorithms for all; calibration start scales with bodyweight if given; prior injuries become limitation tags with conservative mode for 4 weeks.

rules.title: Equipment matrix
rules.statement: No universal superiority; equipment chosen by role (barbell main lifts once technique is reliable, dumbbells for accessories and crowded gyms, machines for planned RIR 0, etc.).

rules.title: Crowded-gym constraints
rules.statement: Supersets within one station; never >2 stations at once; Occupied -> swap or reorder; prefer dumbbells at flagged peak hours.

rules.title: Forgiving weekly streak
rules.statement: Week counts at >= planned-1 sessions (min 2, or 1 if planning 2); one freeze per 4 weeks; never resets to zero.

rules.title: Micro-achievements
rules.statement: First session, calibration, PRs, block completed, session milestones, WHO-floor weeks; never for extreme volume.

rules.title: Stable core, rotating edges
rules.statement: Main lifts fixed per block; accessories rotate between blocks; favourites kept.

rules.title: Time-efficient option
rules.statement: 20-30-min express session always available; habit messaging expects ~2-3 months.

rules.title: Data taxonomy
rules.statement: 11 required, 6 optional items; listed exclusions never collected; all data on-device.
